# Structurizr DSL Reference (`--type c4`)

`brains:diagram --type c4` generates **Structurizr DSL** source, not Mermaid's experimental `C4Context` keyword. Structurizr is the canonical C4 modelling language and produces cleaner SVGs with explicit pixel dimensions via the Kroki PlantUML backend.

Source extension: **`.dsl`** (not `.mmd`). Comment syntax: `#` or `//` (both legal; this skill uses `#` so the auto-trigger marker matches the skill's single-line convention).

## Minimal Workspace

```
# auto-generated by brains:diagram — remove this line to protect manual edits
workspace "System Name" "One-line description" {

  model {
    user = person "User" "Primary actor"
    core = softwareSystem "System Name" "Core system being described"
    ext = softwareSystem "External Service" "Third-party dependency" "External"

    user -> core "Uses" "HTTPS"
    core -> ext "Calls" "REST"
  }

  views {
    systemContext core "SystemContext" {
      include *
      autoLayout lr
    }

    styles {
      element "External" {
        background #999999
        color #ffffff
      }
      element "Person" {
        shape person
      }
    }

    theme default
  }
}
```

## Key Elements

| Construct | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `workspace "name" "description" { … }` | Top-level container. Exactly one per `.dsl` file. |
| `model { … }` | Elements and relationships. |
| `person "label" "description" [tags]` | Internal actor. |
| `softwareSystem "label" "description" [tags]` | Internal or external system. Apply tag `"External"` to style as external. |
| `container "label" "description"` | Container inside a `softwareSystem { … }` block (C4 level 2). |
| `src -> dst "label" "technology"` | Relationship. Both labels optional. |
| `views { systemContext <sys> "key" { … } }` | System-context view — the L1 C4 diagram. |
| `views { container <sys> "key" { … } }` | Container view — the L2 C4 diagram. |
| `include *` | Include every related element automatically. |
| `autoLayout [tb\|lr\|bt\|rl]` | Auto-layout direction. `lr` (left-right) usually fits best for 5-10 elements. |
| `theme default` | Apply the default Structurizr theme. |

## Common Pitfalls

1. **Every container must live inside a `softwareSystem { … }` block.** Declaring `container` at the top level of `model { … }` is a parse error. Wrap the containers in the owning system:
   ```
   brains = softwareSystem "BRAINS" "..." {
     orch = container "Orchestrator" "..."
     teammate = container "Teammate" "..."
   }
   ```

2. **Curly-brace balance is strict.** The parser reports "Unexpected end of DSL content" when a brace is missing. Close every `model`, `views`, `systemContext`, `container`, `styles`, and `workspace` block explicitly.

3. **Tag for External styling.** External systems are styled by **tag**, not by a separate keyword. Pass `"External"` as the third string arg to `softwareSystem` (or add `tags "External"` on a separate line), then define an `element "External" { … }` block in `styles { … }`.

4. **Keep each view focused.** System-context views degrade quickly above 8–10 elements. Split into a `systemContext` + one or more `container` views rather than cramming everything into one diagram.

5. **Kroki renders the first view only.** When a workspace defines multiple views, Kroki's `/structurizr/svg` endpoint renders the first one. If you want a container-level diagram specifically, either put the `container` view first or generate a separate `.dsl` for it.

## When to Emit Container vs Context

The `brains:diagram` auto-trigger chooses `systemContext` by default. Add a `container` view only when the user's description explicitly mentions the components *inside* a system boundary (e.g., "show the services inside the payment system"). A single-view DSL keeps rendering unambiguous.

## Comment Syntax

Structurizr DSL supports three comment styles:

- `#` — line comment. Used by the auto-trigger marker.
- `//` — line comment.
- `/* … */` — block comment.

The auto-trigger marker MUST be the first line of the file with no leading whitespace or BOM, starting with `#`:

```
# auto-generated by brains:diagram — remove this line to protect manual edits
```
